title: Flow Matching with Semidiscrete Couplings
tldr_zh: 用全数据集半离散 OT 势函数替代 minibatch OT 配对，训练时 O(N) MIPS 指派噪声，FID 优于 I-FM 且开销远低于 OT-FM。
tldr_en: Replaces minibatch OT with dataset-level semidiscrete OT potentials; O(N) MIPS pairing at train time beats I-FM on FID with negligible overhead vs OT-FM.
